weight_policy: benchmark-v2 development-selected relative V:G ratio 0.9:0.1; gamma remains the initial 1/3 because historical cases have no independent relevance labels; the generic combined retriever supports H fusion, while the live API returns historical examples as a separate evidence channel; selected without using held-out questions

bm25.selection: grid search on 42-question development set; maximize MRR, then Recall@5, then P@5

normalization.method: per-query min-max within each channel's retrieved candidate pool
normalization.candidate_pool: top max(4 * requested_k, 20) from each channel

fallback.reason: the bounded NetworkX graph was feasible and built
